scope: TOL-004 exact-head authorization and execution audit lifecycle on disposable PostgreSQL and MinIO.

observations.coverage: The durable lifecycle validates correlated append-only authorization, grant-consumption, execution-intent, terminal-outcome, and grant-terminal facts.
observations.limitations: State/audit integration only; no browser, Stack, protected sandbox, Firecracker, or Linux/KVM claim.

redaction: No secrets, identifiers, descriptors, inputs, bodies, credentials, or endpoints are retained.
